children: CAR Group's bull at Citi doesn't sound overly troubled by data showing used vehicle sales fell in one of the Australian advertiser's key markets. Brazil's October used-vehicle sales were 4% lower than a month earlier, and down 9% from a year earlier. However, analyst Siraj Ahmed points out in a note that this includes commercial vehicles, to which CAR's local subsidiary is not exposed. The drop also covers an uncertain period around the country's elections, he adds. While weaker car and motorcycle sales are a headwind, Ahmed sees growth drivers including price rises and media revenue. Citi has a buy rating on the stock and a target price of 33.30 Australian dollars. Shares are up 0.4% at A$25.40. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
